name: Apronal
summary: Apronal (brand name Sedormid), or apronalide, also known as allylisopropylacetylurea or allylisopropylacetylcarbamide, is a hypnotic/sedative drug of the ureide (acylurea) group synthesized in 1926 by Hoffmann-La Roche. Though it is not a barbiturate, apronal is similar in structure to the barbiturates. In accordance, it is similar in action to the barbiturates, although considerably milder in comparison.

uses.text: Upon the finding that it caused patients to develop thrombocytopenic purpura, apronal was withdrawn from clinical use. Medicines with apronal are no longer used except in Japan and South Korea.

summaryZh: 丙戊醯脲（英語：Apronal or Apronalide），又名烯丙基異丙基乙醯脲，商品名司眠脲等，是一種醯脲類鎮靜催眠藥物，由霍夫曼-羅氏公司於1926年合成。儘管丙戊醯脲並非巴比妥類藥物，它的化學結構與巴比妥類藥物相似（它是一個開鏈脲，而不是雜環化合物）。
summaryZhHans: 丙戊酰脲（英语：Apronal or Apronalide），又名烯丙基异丙基乙酰脲，商品名司眠脲等，是一种酰脲类镇静催眠药物，由霍夫曼-罗氏公司于1926年合成。尽管丙戊酰脲并非巴比妥类药物，它的化学结构与巴比妥类药物相似（它是一个开链脲，而不是杂环化合物）。

pharmacology.en: It is an acylurea sedative, a simpler relative of the barbiturates. It is thought to calm the brain by acting on GABA-A receptors, the brain's main inhibitory switch.
pharmacology.zh: 它是醯基尿素類鎮靜劑，是巴比妥類較簡單的親戚。一般認為它透過作用於大腦主要的抑制開關 GABA-A 受體來平靜腦部活動。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是酰基尿素类镇静剂，是巴比妥类较简单的亲戚。一般认为它通过作用于大脑主要的抑制开关 GABA-A 受体来平静脑部活动。

sideEffects.en: It causes drowsiness and poor coordination, and it was withdrawn because it caused thrombocytopenic purpura, a sharp fall in platelets leading to bruising and bleeding, which can be serious.
sideEffects.zh: 它會造成嗜睡與協調變差，並因引起血小板低下性紫斑症而下市，也就是血小板急遽下降導致瘀青與出血，可能相當嚴重。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会造成嗜睡与协调制差，并因引起血小板低下性紫斑症而下市，也就是血小板急遽下降导致瘀青与出血，可能相当严重。

fact.en: Apronal, sold as Sedormid, has a place in medical history: studying the bruising it caused led researchers in the 1950s to work out how drugs can make the immune system destroy platelets.
fact.zh: 丙戊醯脲以 Sedormid 之名販售，在醫學史上佔有一席之地：1950 年代研究人員透過研究它造成的瘀青，釐清了藥物如何使免疫系統破壞血小板。
fact.zhHans: 丙戊酰脲以 Sedormid 之名贩售，在医学史上占有一席之地：1950 年代研究人员通过研究它造成的瘀青，厘清了药物如何使免疫系统破坏血小板。
